text: The death of Alexander having put an end to all his great reference, the eastern part of his dominions devoted first on Pyde the son of Agence, and afterwards on Seleucus. The latter was very sensible of the advantage to the derived from keeping India in its projection. With this the underside mix ex-of Selecuse pedilion into that country, partly to establish him to India. Authority more perfectly, and partly to defend the Macedonia territories against Sanderson King of the Prasti, who threatened to attack them. The particulation of his expedition are very little towns; albeit being the only author that mentions them, and his authority in but of little weight, unless corroborated by the tenancy of other historians. Pittersch, who tells us that Selecons carried his names further into India than Alexander, is subject to an inspiration of the same body but Putty, whose authority for of considerably greater weight, corroborates the tenitoy of Pitarta to this instance, though this works are so obscure, that learned men differ in opinion concerning their meaning. Bayern thinke they imply that Selecus managed from the Hyghacs, the boundary of Alexander’s congests, to the Hydration, from theme to Pali-bohra, and then to the mouth of the Ganges ; the distances of the principal stations being marked, and amounting in all to 242 Russian miles. Notwithstanding this authority, however, Dr. Robertson thinks it very improbends that the expedition of Selecuses should have continued so long, as in the case "the animals would have had a more accurate knowledge of that part of the country that they seen ever to have possessed?"
